question: In which year did Anil Kumble take 10 wickets in a cricket test match?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1999**__.

• Anil Kumble is famously known as "Jumbo" in the cricketing fraternity.
 
• He earned this nickname due to his fast bowling speeds and his large, imposing physical presence.

• The full form of BCCI is the Board of Control for Cricket in India.
 
• The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) is the governing body for cricket in India and is under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, the Government of India.
 
 
• It is an autonomous organization and does not come under the National sports federation of India.
 
• The board was formed in December 1928 as a society, registered under the Tamil Nadu Societies Registration Act.
 
 
 
• BCCI is an autonomous body and does not review any grants or fundings from the Sports Ministry of India.
